name: Mechanical Clover

features.name: Respin to 27 ways
features.description: The respin feature expands winning combinations from 5 lines to 27.

features.name: Higher-card gamble
features.description: Beat the dealer's card to double a win, up to 10 times.

review:
A steampunk 3x3 with five lines that looks gentle and isn't. It's rated high volatility, and the max is a wild 24,360x – unusually high for such a small grid.

That ceiling comes from the Respin feature, which can open the game up from 5 lines to 27. The gamble is different too: pick a card, and if it beats the dealer's, your win doubles – up to 10 times in a row, risking everything each time. 95.42% RTP. Go easy on that gamble.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
